ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account action against the driver.
ruling.reasoning:
The cancellation is a rider cancellation 2 min 30 s after matching (accepted 18:23:00, cancelled 18:25:30) [F2], so the only gateway to the $6.61 fee is NS-0 (cancelled_by = rider → NS-4); no driver-side no-show cancellation occurred [F2][RD-6 not implicated]. Under NS-4, a cancellation within 3 minutes of matching (≤ 3:00) is not chargeable, and the trace confirms the fee window failed (150 s) [F2][F5][NS-4].

The fee cannot be saved through the no-show branch either: the driver's closest approach to the pickup was 1816 m and he never came within 200 m [F1], the platform recorded no arrival (driver_arrived_at null) [F3], and there was no "I'm Here" tap and no automatic arrival [F4]. NS-1 (ii) is therefore unsatisfied, and the driver's written statement that he "was on my way" [F10] is a post-hoc claim that yields to the GPS and timeline records [F1][F3][F4][NS-1][NS-2]. His chat message at 18:24 saying "5 min more, traffic is slow" [F8] corroborates that he had not reached the pickup point when the rider cancelled [F1][NS-1].

The driver's delay is not excused by the traffic picture in any way that earns the fee: Jurong East Avenue 1 shows only speed band 4 (30–39 km/h), i.e. not a band 1/2 record [F11], no traffic incidents were recorded on the route [F12], and the weather was fair with no rain [F13]; in any event RD-4-type evidence could only excuse a measured off-route segment, and here there is no off-route segment to excuse — this is a pre-pickup cancellation [F11][F12][F13][NS-4]. Since no segment of the route was driven, segment_findings is empty.

The chat record is complete: 2 messages, every one timestamped, so timing and the driver's distance are determinable without a G12 referral [F9]. The claimed amount is the cancellation fee itself: $6.61 [F5][F2][NS-4], which under NS-7 is disbursed as a Ryde voucher; no cash refund is ordered [NS-7]. The safety screen found nothing: the chat consists of a query about ETA [F7] and a delay reply [F8], and the driver's statement is a neutral assertion of travel [F10]; the complaint alleges only non-arrival and overcharging — no threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation [F7][F8][F10][SAFE-1][SAFE-2]. Profile facts (rider clean history [F14]; driver clean history [F15]) are noted only in support and do not decide the case; no flag_account is warranted since no RD-6/NS-2 trigger applies.
